prompt:

Icon artwork and glow must fit within the central 72% of EACH cell, leaving generous EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters along every cell edge. Every icon precisely centered in its own cell. No art crossing cells. All cells identical size and aligned. Individual silhouettes easy to recognize at 48 pixels.
Exact row-major placement:
Row 1 col 1: Iron Helm — a complete closed-face steel helmet with eye slit and gold brow, clearly HEAD armor only, no torso.

Row 3 col 3: Wayfarer Boots — a pair of complete brown leather footwear boots.

Row 4 col 3: War Ring — one actual thick engraved iron finger ring with red inlay, circular band hole obvious, no sword.

Preserve EXACT 4x5 grid and exact object order. No UI panels or captions. Full silhouettes fully visible with generous transparent padding inside each cell.
